description: Share an idea with people or with the whole workspace, or stop sharing it. Works on Backlog ideas, so teammates can see one and pick it up, and on Active ideas. Say who you are about to share with before calling, and never share with the workspace unless the person asked for it. People in the workspace get the idea in their inbox; anyone else gets an email invitation.

idea_short_id.description: The first 8 characters of the idea UUID.

people.description: People to share with, by email. Role defaults to editor, which lets them pick the idea up.

remove_people.description: Emails of people to take off the idea.

workspace.description: 'workspace' shares with every workspace member; 'private' stops that.

workspace_role.description: Role for the workspace share. Default: editor.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: share_idea
